content.text:
I'm not deciding anything today, Avi. I'll ask you when you come over, and maybe I'll ask at the bank too.

Here's what I took from it. At the top I typed nothing. The boxes already said 10,000 ₪ to start, 500 a month, 10 years and 7%. With that, it says I put in "70,000 ₪" and get back "84,184 ₪", "אחרי דמי ניהול ומס, בכסף של היום". But the 84,184 comes from a company called "אינטראקטיב ישראל (מותג של MEXEM LTD)". I never heard of it, and I wouldn't give my money to it. Then I looked further down for the banks I know. Leumi gives "71,513 ₪", Mizrahi "69,201 ₪" and Hapoalim "68,511 ₪". So at a big bank my 70,000 hardly grows in ten years. The small grey number under each bank (15,351 at Leumi, 18,548 at Hapoalim) I think is what they take, but I'm not sure. If it is, the bank takes a lot. It also says "אם הדולר לא זז מול השקל", so it isn't a sure thing anyway. I'm not very sure of any of it.

**What I looked at, in order:**
1. The big heading "איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד" and the row of buttons with "S&P 500" lit up.
2. The four boxes with sliders. I left the numbers as they were.
3. The two big numbers: 84,184 "הבחירה שלכם" and 86,492 "הזוג הזול ביותר".
4. On the next screens, the list of companies on the right with their numbers.

On the left was a long list of funds with English names and coloured labels. I skipped it, and the boxes with long writing under "אין נתון". I stopped around the fifth screen, at the part with "חוקים וכללים", because I was tired and worried.

**Words I didn't understand:** "זוג", "מנוטרל מט״ח", "צוברת", "מחלקת דיבידנד", "קרן מחקה", "תעודת סל", "4D", "דמי משמרת", "עמלות זו על זו", "קרן חוץ", "W-8BEN", "עוד לא נאסף", "אין מחיר כאן", "מול המדד", and "UCITS", "ETF", "MEXEM".

**What I couldn't read or follow:** The screen is black with grey letters, and the small grey lines were hard even with glasses. The coloured bars I couldn't tell apart. In the list of funds there were numbers with a minus, like "−533 ₪" and "−2.44%". They made me want to stay away.
